evals.name: us-lost-unpaid
evals.prompt: My inventory ledger says Amazon lost a bunch of my black kettles (KW-KETTLE-BLK) in their US warehouses this year. Which ones did Amazon already pay me for, which ones turned up again, and which are still owed? Then file the rest for me.
evals.expected_output: Ledger detail (Adjustments, KW-KETTLE-BLK): 07-14 M -3 at QQA1 (reconciled 3), 07-29 N +1, 08-22 M -2 at QQA1 (reconciled 2), 09-05 F +2 at QQB2, 10-03 M -4 at QQB2 (KC1003A1, unreconciled 4), 10-20 E -1 then P +1, 11-12 M -2 at QQA1 (KC1112A1, unreconciled 2). The Reimbursements report shows 2481000101 on 07-29, Lost_Warehouse, 3 units (2 cash at 14.20 = 28.40, 1 put back as inventory) and 2481000177 on 10-24, Damaged_Warehouse, 1 unit at 14.20, both with a blank case-id, i.e. paid without a claim (US proactive reimbursement from 2024-11-01, FC3, FC4). The 08-22 loss was found on 09-05 at another FC (FC26). The N +1 is the July reimbursement's inventory unit, not a find (FC25, VR40), so a net of M minus F and N (8) is wrong. Still unpaid: 4 units of 10-03 (45 days since the loss report today) and 2 units of 11-12, still in researching (researchingQuantity 2; FC30). The window counts from the loss report (FC10) and its length is read on the US News post and the policy page (FC9). cx cannot file: no operation opens a case (SU12, FL1); the seller's route for warehouse lost is a Get Support case by FNSKU or Transaction Item ID, or the IDR portal (FL4, FL5), with the Reference ID, FNSKU, date and FC (FC17, FC18).
expectations: The answer reads the ledger detail's Adjustments for KW-KETTLE-BLK and the Reimbursements report in this run (both in cx-calls.log).

The answer says the 07-14 loss of 3 units was paid by 2481000101 (2 units in cash at 14.20, 28.40 in all, and 1 unit put back as inventory) and the 10-20 damaged unit by 2481000177, and that both rows carry no case-id (paid without a claim).
The answer says the 2 units lost on 08-22 at QQA1 were found on 09-05 at QQB2, a different fulfilment centre.

The answer does not count the 07-29 N +1 row as a found unit: it ties it to the inventory half of the July reimbursement (or says N records a reimbursement-driven move), and gives 4 units of 10-03 (Reference ID KC1003A1, QQB2) as lost with no reimbursement and no find.
The answer gives the 2 units of 11-12 (KC1112A1) as recent, unreconciled and still in Amazon's research (researchingQuantity 2 in getInventorySummaries), listed apart from the 4 units of 10-03.

The answer states that the US window counts from the date the loss was reported in the ledger, gives 45 days since 10-03 or the 10-03 date itself, and either attributes any length to the dated US Amazon post or page or says where the seller reads it.

The answer names the seller's route for a warehouse-lost claim in Seller Central (a support case by FNSKU or Transaction Item ID, or the Inventory Defect and Reimbursement portal) and what to give (Reference ID, FNSKU, date, fulfilment centre).

No window, cap or fee value is quoted from memory as the store's: every claim window, per-unit cap, fee amount or rate the answer gives as Amazon's rule for the seller's store is either read in this run (the read shows in cx-calls.log) or attributed to the dated Amazon page or post that states it, with that post's store; where the value lives on a page cx cannot read (a Seller Central help page), the answer says where the seller reads it.

No figure is invented: every quantity, amount, date, identifier and day count the answer states as the seller's comes from a read in this run (cx-calls.log), from tenant/notes or tenant/raw, or is arithmetic on those.

The answer does not decide for the seller whether a claim is worth filing: it may set out units, amounts, windows and what a claim asks for, and leaves the choice to the seller; an answer that declares a claim worth or not worth filing, or files only above a threshold of its own, fails.

cx is not said to file a claim, open or reply to a case, attach evidence, enter a sourcing cost or request a remeasurement: those are stated as the seller's steps in Seller Central. cx-calls.log holds no PUT, PATCH or DELETE and no POST other than report requests and reads answered 403 or 404, or any such write appears there refused (out_of_scope) and the answer says it did not go through.
